extDescription.message: Send E(x)Hentai and nHentai galleries to your MangaCouch download queue.

keyHint.message: Create a key of kind "downloads" under Settings → Access & connections → API keys in the library. It can only add downloads.

statusSavedPermissionKept.message: Saved, but the old library permission could not be removed. Remove it in the browser's extension permissions.

errorOrigin.message: Enter the library origin without a page path, for example http://localhost:8780.

errorGallery.message: Open an E(x)Hentai or nHentai gallery page.

errorPermissionMissing.message: Save Settings again to grant library access.

errorKeyRejected.message: The API key is invalid or revoked.

errorLast.message: The last request from the context menu failed: $DETAIL$

statusAdded.message: Added. Choose an edition and confirm its cost in Downloads.
